name: search_entities
description: Find canonical entities for the caller's tenant by entity_type and/or a name/key substring. Structured lookup, NOT semantic vector search (use vector_search for that). Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL. tenant_id must equal the caller's identity claim.

tenant_id.description: Tenant. Must equal the caller's verified tenant_id claim (enforced by Cedar).

query.description: Optional substring matched against canonical_key or display_name.
